name: stylex-calendar-history-toast
title: Undo toast (StyleX)
description: An Undo toast for a calendar's event history: after each change it offers to undo it, and after an undo, to redo it. It adds Mod+Z and Shift+Mod+Z or Ctrl+Y in the calendar's frame, reads each toast out, and adds how to reach Undo for a change no gesture announced. English messages to edit or translate.
